svg.title: M grouping after M wave packing

cc:Work.dc:title: M grouping after M wave packing
cc:Work.dc:description: Graph time reductions for wave packings (2,1) and (2,2). Left: fixed geometry with only group_m changed. Right: independently tuned traversal branches. Whiskers show the range across three seeds.
